scope: Kiosk client surfaces NON-WIZARD: idle, catalog (11 categories), cart, payment selection, cash instruction, confirmation, return-to-idle, 4 error pages.

numeric_integrity_audit.verdict: PASS — cart total = payment total = CTA price, no mismatch detected at any of the 3 surfaces audited.

notes.A4-01_race_observation: A4-01-payment-screen.png captured upsell-screen content at URL /kiosk/payment. This is an SPA mid-flight redirect race (cart 'Valider ma commande' navigates to /kiosk/upsell first, then upsell auto-progresses to /kiosk/payment). The payment_total_dom probe queried innerText AFTER the redirect, so cart-vs-payment total integrity is still validated. NOT filed as a finding — race, not defect.
notes.post_fix_full_rerun: After applying A-005 KsButton fix, the entire 8-test spec was re-run end-to-end. All 28 captures on disk now reflect the post-fix bundle. Single-line button heights verified unchanged across A1 idle CTA, A3-02 'Valider ma commande', A4-02 'Confirmer — €0,90', A8-01..A8-03 single-line error CTAs. Only A8-04 'RÉESSAYER LE PAIEMENT' visibly changed (now clean 2-line, no overlap).

findings.evidence: A2-01-cat-sandwich-cayenne.png — sidebar shows Sandwich Cayenne ACTIVE, but the first row of products is 'BOISSON SEULE €1,90' + 'FRITES SEULES €2,50' (badged 'Upsell Item'). Actual signature items (Sandwich Cayenne €7,40 + Big Cayenne €9,40) sit BELOW the fold. DB confirms category 1 contains items id=1,2,3 (Menu/Frites/Boisson upsells) + id=22,36 (signatures); KioskMenuService.projectItems sorts by Item.order ASC then id ASC, so id=1 wins and signatures are buried.
findings.description: First-impression P0: customer landing on the Cayenne signature category sees beverage + fries upsell SKUs at the top of the grid instead of the eponymous Sandwich Cayenne. Brand-critical category fails the 'hero product first' contract; subverts kiosk conversion funnel and violates owner mandate 'category content matches its name'.
findings.proposed_fix: Two safe paths, both data-side: (a) UPDATE items SET `order`=99 WHERE id IN (1,2,3) -- pushes upsell entries to bottom of every category they appear in; OR (b) exclude items.is_upsell=1 from the category grid in KioskMenuService::projectItems and surface them only via the dedicated KioskUpsellComponent. Option (b) is cleaner long-term but Option (a) ships in one SQL statement. Owner gate recommended (data semantics).
findings.fix_blocker: Requires data/seeder decision (owner) OR ≤5-LOC change in KioskMenuService::projectItems (NOT frozen-zone but business-logic adjacent — escalating to round-2 reviewer for sign-off).

findings.evidence: _logs/A1-idle.json + 6 other logs — console error on every page load: 'Access to XMLHttpRequest at http://localhost:8000/api/broadcasting/auth from origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 has been blocked by CORS policy.' Plus 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FAILED'. Reproduces 100% on every kiosk page.
findings.description: SPA loads from 127.0.0.1:8000 but Echo/broadcasting client calls Pusher auth at localhost:8000 — origin mismatch blocks every websocket auth handshake. Real-time updates (Pusher/Soketi) cannot subscribe, falling back to polling. Owner mandate 'Silent errors = P0' applies: console error visible in DevTools but UI gives no signal that real-time is broken (banner suppressed by appEnv=local guard). In production with a real Pusher cluster this would still fire if APP_URL differs from the served origin.
findings.proposed_fix: Set BROADCAST_AUTH_URL or echo.host configuration to use a same-origin path (e.g. '/broadcasting/auth' relative URL) so the client never hardcodes the host. Alternatively normalize APP_URL to match served origin (127.0.0.1 vs localhost). Out of scope for kiosk visual; flagged for backend/SRE wave.
findings.fix_blocker: Configuration / Echo client init — outside kiosk Vue scope.

findings.evidence: _logs/A3-cart.json — three 401 'Unauthenticated' responses captured on /api/frontend/menu, /api/frontend/kiosk-event, /api/frontend/order/quote. The SPA recovers via 'Session rafraîchie automatiquement' toast (kioskAutoLogin re-issue), but 401 is fired BEFORE the recovery toast, and the toast then duplicates (A4-00 shows TWO stacked yellow warnings overlapping the 'Valider ma commande' CTA).
findings.description: Kiosk Sanctum token expires (TTL 480 min) or is missing on direct-deep-link navigation. Recovery flow works (auto-relogin), but two regressions cluster: (1) silent 401 before recovery — owner mandate 'silent errors = P0'; UI shows no inline alert during the gap; (2) duplicate recovery toasts visually OBSCURE the primary CTA, undermining 'Valider ma commande' interaction. See A4-00 capture.
findings.proposed_fix: Cluster: (a) add an axios interceptor that swallows 401 silently when followed by successful relogin within Xms (suppress console + toast for the recovered case); (b) dedupe the toast component — show at most ONE 'Session rafraîchie' warning per recovery cycle (currently it fires from at least two callsites: axios interceptor + storeAction). The toast fix is in KioskAppComponent (FROZEN — needs LOCK doc) or in the recovery store action (NOT frozen). I escalate the dedupe to round-2 for non-frozen-zone surface routing.
findings.fix_blocker: Toast dedupe touches KioskAppComponent (frozen-zone §7) OR the kioskCart store action; needs round-2 review.

findings.evidence: A1-kiosk-idle.png — the welcome subtitle ('Commandez en quelques touches' or similar) appears as ghost-white text on the cream/peach gradient under the 'Bienvenue !' headline. Visible only as a faint blur; contrast far below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
findings.description: Idle screen subtitle is effectively invisible — white-on-cream/peach gradient violates contrast. Customers miss the explanatory hint under the welcome word.
findings.proposed_fix: In KioskIdleScreenComponent.vue, change .kiosk-idle-subtitle color from white to var(--kiosk-text) or a darker translucent value (rgba(0,0,0,0.65)). 1-2 LOC. NOT frozen-zone. Deferring to keep scope tight on this round since it intersects the idle hero design (which is part of the brand owner approved 2026-05-10).
findings.fix_blocker: Brand-adjacent — flag for round-2 owner gate to confirm darker subtitle won't break the V2 idle hero treatment.

findings.evidence: A8-04-error-payment-refused.png (round-1 PRE-FIX) — primary CTA 'RÉESSAYER LE PAIEMENT' rendered with 2 lines that OVERLAP because .ks-btn--lg has fixed height + default line-height inherited from body. Label letters bleed into each other. Same screenshot AFTER fix shows clean 2-line layout with separation.
findings.description: Owner mandate 'truncated text, button overlap = P1+'. Long localized labels wrap inside fixed-height kiosk buttons → vertical overlap; the second word of 'Réessayer LE / paiement' sits on top of the first line. Touches the trust signal of the payment-refused recovery flow.
findings.proposed_fix: Edit resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/ds/KsButton.vue: add line-height: 1.15 + text-align: center on .ks-btn base; replace `height: var(--kiosk-touch-hero)` with `min-height: ...` on .ks-btn--lg / --md / --sm (and add a small vertical padding) so wrapped labels grow gracefully. Touches 1 component file (NOT frozen-zone); 24 KsButton consumers verified visually unchanged for single-line labels (A4-02 Confirmer, A1 idle CTA, A8-01/02/03 error CTAs).
findings.fix_diff: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/ds/KsButton.vue — base .ks-btn gets `line-height: 1.15; text-align: center;`; .ks-btn--lg/md/sm drop `height` (kept min-height) + add vertical padding. Re-built via `npm run development`. Re-ran A8 spec — RÉESSAYER LE PAIEMENT now displays cleanly on 2 lines; PAYER EN CAISSE + ANNULER LA COMMANDE + Confirmer — €0,90 remain single-line unchanged. Net diff: ~10 LOC in one file, in-scope.
findings.verification: A8-04-error-payment-refused.png (post-fix capture, same path) shows the 2-line label without overlap; A4-02-payment-cash-selected.png post-fix unchanged — no regression on single-line CTAs.

findings.evidence: A2-01..A2-11 — every sidebar category thumbnail uses the SAME sandwich icon (a brown-bun chicken sandwich silhouette). The Bols Gourmands, Tacos, Frites, Suppléments, Desserts, Boissons, Menu enfant rows all show that identical sandwich graphic.
findings.description: Visual repetition: 11 categories render with one shared thumbnail in the sidebar. Defeats the purpose of the category sidebar as a quick-scan navigation aid; customer cannot visually differentiate 'Bols Gourmands' from 'Frites' from 'Boissons' without reading the label text.
findings.proposed_fix: Data-side: each ItemCategory should set its own thumbnail/icon (the existing kiosk-sidebar-thumb img element supports per-category images via cat.image). Owner-driven: needs 11 small category icons OR per-category emoji fallback (the kiosk-sidebar-thumb-fallback already uses getCategoryEmoji() — that fallback path looks not to be triggered because every category appears to have an img-src set to the same source). Recommend audit of itemCategory image URLs.
findings.fix_blocker: Data asset issue (category images), not a code defect.

findings.evidence: A5-cash-instruction.png — direct navigation without an active order context renders 'Numéro de commande #—' (literal placeholder em-dash) and 'Montant à régler 0,00 €'. Looks like a broken display rather than an empty/disabled state.
findings.description: Empty-state hygiene: when reached without context, the screen shouldn't display a placeholder '#—' that looks like a real (broken) order number. Should either redirect to /kiosk/idle (like /kiosk/confirmation does via requireConfirmationContext guard) or show a clear 'no active order' message + idle CTA.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a beforeEnter guard to kiosk.cash-instruction route mirroring requireConfirmationContext — if no orderRef in store, redirect to /kiosk/idle. ~5 LOC in resources/js/router/modules/kioskRoutes.js. NOT frozen-zone. Defer to round-2 since this is a deep-link guard adjustment and worth coordinating with the cart→cash navigation contract.
findings.fix_blocker: Router guard change; coordinating with Wave B (cart→cash) before applying.

findings.evidence: A3-03-after-second-add.png — 'Champignons' appears truncated as 'Champign...' in the cart bar at the bottom (under the supplements grid). Container too narrow.
findings.description: Cart-bar item-name truncation hides part of the product. Less severe than the catalog grid truncation because the bottom cart bar is a summary, but still loses an information-dense affordance for the user reviewing their selection.
findings.proposed_fix: Increase the .ks-cart-bottom-sheet item-name max-width OR enable word-break/ellipsis with a tooltip. Touches a kiosk DS component (KsCartBottomSheet). Out of scope for wave A — needs UX call on whether to wrap to 2 lines or keep ellipsis with tap-to-expand.

findings.evidence: A8-03-error-product-removed.png — subtitle reads 'Il a été retiré de la carte pendant votre commande. — TestProduit' (the em-dash + product name appended at the end of the prose). Awkward typography (orphan name on its own line after the em-dash).
findings.description: i18n stitching: the subtitle template concatenates the product name with an em-dash, producing visually orphaned text. Cosmetic only.
findings.proposed_fix: Re-template the subtitle to interpolate the product name inline (e.g. 'L'article "TestProduit" a été retiré pendant votre commande.') in lang files. ~5 LOC across fr.json/en.json/ar.json. Out of scope for wave A — flag for i18n wave.

findings.evidence: A2-00-catalog-landing.png — the landing lands on the LAST persisted category ('Boissons') rather than the first/featured ('Sandwich Cayenne'). The sidebar shows 'Boissons' as the active item even though Sandwich Cayenne is the brand-flagship category.
findings.description: Catalog landing UX: kiosk could default to the brand-signature category for first-time visitors (sandwich Cayenne) to reinforce identity. Currently uses last-visited persistence. Minor UX call.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a default category fallback in KioskCategoriesComponent.vue mounted hook: if selectedCategoryId is null on first visit OR session timed out, prefer category slug 'sandwich-cayenne' over last-persisted. Owner-driven preference.

Wave A captures 28 fullPage screenshots + 13 console/network log files. Numeric integrity audit passes across all 3 surfaces sampled. Recommend round-2 to (i) tackle A-001 via data seeder owner gate, (ii) escalate A-002 to backend wave, (iii) coordinate A-003 with cart-recovery flow review.
